d:
A side-story follow-up to the first chapter of "Seigi no Hero! Goukanman!", in which the blackmailing gal - carnally and mentally inspired by the intervention she received from Goukanman, decides to follow in his footsteps and become Goukangyaru, or Gokan Girl.

Alas, things don't quite go as planned...

If you wanna check out and support the artist, search Hanazawa Suou (花澤すおう) on Pixiv and Fantia
